failure_and_rollback.rollback_scope: the eleven create targets only, in the same attempt, when any acceptance-critical pre-evidence check fails and every current target still matches its immutable attempt-produced postimage identity; no rollback is authorized after evidence finalization
failure_and_rollback.postimage_identity_guard: immediately after the create batch and before validation, record SHA-256 and size_bytes for each of the eleven targets; immediately before rollback, recompute all eleven; require exact equality for every target before deleting any target
failure_and_rollback.identity_mismatch_behavior: if any target is absent or its current SHA-256 or size_bytes differs from the recorded attempt-produced postimage, perform no file deletion and no directory removal; preserve all targets, record E_ROLLBACK_POSTIMAGE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH, and stop for owner inspection
failure_and_rollback.rollback_method: after the all-target postimage identity guard passes, use one exact apply_patch deletion batch, then rmdir -- in this exact deepest-first order only when each directory is empty: arcana/distill/profiles/v2/techniques, arcana/distill/profiles/v2, arcana/distill/profiles, arcana/distill/schemas, arcana/distill/development/fixtures/v2/schema/technique-spec, arcana/distill/development/fixtures/v2/schema, arcana/distill/development/fixtures/v2; never rm, glob, reset, checkout, or clean
failure_and_rollback.nonempty_directory_behavior: block and preserve; never force removal
failure_and_rollback.post_evidence_failure_behavior: preserve all implementation targets, evidence documents, and directories without mutation; return the failing read-only outer validation status and stop for owner inspection
failure_and_rollback.retry_policy: no implicit retry; a new attempt requires fresh baselines and explicit user continuation
